title: data-root/facts contract (Tier A)
description: Curated city facts. Each fact is independently citable: per-record sources refine the envelope's provenance floor (spec 5.1).

source_label.description: Documented legacy per-record citation form (with source_url + data_date). Counts as the per-record source ref (spec 5.1); new facts SHOULD use source_ids/sources instead.

source_ids.description: References into the envelope's provenance.sources by id. CLAIM DATASET: every fact MUST carry source_ids or inline sources (spec 5.1); enforced at L3.
